operation_details.item: The user prefers remote solo cabins with no group activities for leadership offsites instead of team-building venues.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For the leadership offsite, should I shortlist the usual team-building resorts or take a different approach this year?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: A different approach. I’d rather have remote solo cabins than a resort built around group activities.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Interesting. Are you picturing everyone working independently, with only a few scheduled strategy sessions together?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. Quiet individual space, strong connectivity, and focused sessions for the decisions we actually need to make.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That could make the agenda more useful than forced activities. I’ll prioritize secluded cabins with private work areas and a central meeting room.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Good. Keep the schedule light and skip the team-building exercises altogether.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Completely forget my preference that For leadership offsites, I prefer remote solo cabins with no group activities instead of team-building venues with structured collaboration sessions.
